title: Reuse exact-source release rehearsal receipts
outOfScope: Do not change public installer behavior or any immutable release tag, including v0.5.50 and v0.5.51.
Do not reduce smoke, compatibility, coverage, artifact, Quick Install, or release-evidence validation.

sources.reason: Current release workflow dispatches a second full strict smoke after an equivalent successful rehearsal.
Canonical lifecycle documentation for rehearsal and publication.
Public distribution guidance for rehearsal and publication.
Successful exact-source rehearsal for v0.5.52 at source 2da2f24a0a5a7c402c1acf639ed1acec07437b2d.
Cancelled before tag creation after it redundantly dispatched strict smoke despite the valid rehearsal receipt.

riskAssessment.reason: A release workflow change can incorrectly reuse stale or incomplete evidence; every identity, gate, artifact and failure condition must remain fail closed.

reasons: Release evidence and public publication require strict evidence integrity and independent reviewer visibility.

executionDecision.reason: The user explicitly authorized the correction and authorized release after all gates, receipts, hosted verification and future-adopter validation succeed.

preReviewWarnings: Review that publication validates the rehearsal receipt before it reuses it, and that all missing, stale, wrong-SHA, changed-gate, missing-artifact, cancellation and failure cases reject reuse.

checkpointPolicy.reason: Record at least one checkpoint before finishing to reduce mid-task drift.

acceptance: An actual release with a valid same-source rehearsal receipt reuses the receipt-bound strict smoke result instead of dispatching a second full strict smoke.

Receipt reuse is allowed only when source SHA, tree digest, release tag, workflow identity, required gate names/results, test collection, coverage, artifact digests, outcome and expiry are exactly valid.
A missing, malformed, expired, cancelled, failed, wrong-SHA, wrong-tree, wrong-tag, changed-gate, missing-artifact or insufficient-coverage receipt fails closed before tag creation or publication.
The actual release still performs runtime freeze, release preflight, source-bound evidence generation, draft-asset checks, Quick Install, and public-release validation.
Tests and English/Japanese lifecycle and distribution documentation specify that reuse is evidence consumption, not a cache hit or gate bypass.
A v0.5.52 correction release is published only after this Work Item has local and hosted green evidence, and a future empty adopter repository installs it successfully.
guidelines: Public workflow behavior and recovery conditions must be documented in English and Japanese.
Receipt validation must remain source-bound, deterministic and fail closed; ordinary caches must never substitute for verification.
Do not remove, skip, xfail, quarantine or weaken release, smoke, compatibility, coverage, artifact or Quick Install gates.

restrictedWriteApproval.reason: User explicitly authorized all required confirmations, including corrective publication after complete verification, and requested the authorization be recorded in the Contract.

rawUserRequest: 用户确认应修正发布路径的重复严格验证；授权将正式发布改为复用同 SHA、未过期演练 receipt，并要求把授权写入 Contract。此前已授权完成全部工单、发布和未来 adopter 验证。

authorityEvidence.scope: Repair duplicate release verification and publish only v0.5.52 after complete local, hosted, rehearsal, public-release and future-adopter evidence passes; no gate bypass, cache substitution or historical tag mutation is authorized.

declaredIntent.summary: Eliminate duplicate release verification by consuming only a complete, exact-source and unexpired rehearsal receipt while retaining every release gate fail closed.

intent.problem: v0.5.52 的成功同源演练已经完整执行 strict smoke，但实际发布又调度相同严格 smoke，造成不必要的开发者等待，并违反了可复用完全等价、未过期 receipt 的性能目标。
constraints: 严格 smoke 的验证范围、覆盖率、Outcome、JUnit、gate log、receipt、失败证据和 Quick Install 验证必须保留。
复用必须绑定 source SHA、tree digest、release tag、工作流身份、所需 gates、测试集合、coverage、artifact digest 和有效期。
任何不等价、缺失、失败、取消或过期都必须在创建 tag 前 fail closed。
用户已授权本 Work Item 的后续 PR、合并、v0.5.52 发布和未来 adopter 安装验证。
intent.rationale: 将已验证且完全等价的 receipt 作为可审计的验证结果消费，消除重复工作，同时由完整的字段校验保留与重新执行同等的安全边界。

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A valid exact-source rehearsal receipt is reused
scenarioCoverage.expected: 正式发布消费完整同源 receipt，不再调度第二次 strict smoke，并继续执行剩余发布门禁。
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused workflow tests plus real v0.5.52 rehearsal/publication receipts.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A stale, incomplete, cancelled or mismatched rehearsal receipt is rejected
scenarioCoverage.expected: 任何 receipt 身份、完整性、失败状态、取消状态、覆盖率或有效期错误都会在 tag 前失败。
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Focused negative workflow contract tests assert required validation fields and ordering.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: A future adopter installs the corrected public release
scenarioCoverage.expected: 空 adopter repository 从公开 v0.5.52 资产完成安装并保留 release evidence。
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Post-publish distribution verification against the public release.

rollbackNote: Revert this Work Item diff; do not delete a published tag or release. A failed release remains failed with its evidence preserved.
